answer: The admission bond is time locked for 30 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are written down in quill, expire in nectar, and copper lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 143 aliases therefore needs 181 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The per-identity price is 5 dollars, and it is forfeited outright on the first bad verdict. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
